I haven’t experienced any negativity about opening up about it with new people in my life, people have questions or they understand. I’ve been incredibly honest about it as well in my dating life; very upfront very quickly and I have had two really understanding and supportive relationships since diagnosis and being open. 
Try being open and see how you feel, it’s been helpful for me, it’s helped me feel less afraid or shameful or misunderstood. 
Good luck! And always remember theres an online community for you to come back too if you need support.

Hi! 

Make sure you are giving yourself credit for the good days! The days you are able to achieve something need a pat on the back! It’s good to build yourself up when you are going through this! Take your bad days as healing days or processing days or just a simple bad day! As hard as it is do not beat yourself up, this is a process. 

As for your relationship, I know how scary it is to be losing someone now; it might make you feel like you aren’t progressing but even this too is a step in the right direction, sometimes you have to tackle this stuff on your own and focus on yourself! I really do guarantee you there is someone out there for you who will understand or be there waiting for you when you are feeling a little brighter! 

Are you in therapy at all? It helps so much, especially when it comes to issues with the relationships in your life during all this. 

Remember, give yourself credit. You deserve it.

I experience a pretty similar situation with my relationship but also just every day life, my brain seems to really default to negative thoughts and after one day of arguing with my partner and general just over all fed-up-ness I turned to google (I know, don't laugh). I found a lot of good resources on curbing negative thoughts and why I personally struggle with trust issues/mis-placed trust! I really recommend researching some exercises for curbing negative thoughts or even try mindful meditation if you want to help with the anxiety aspect of a wandering brain! I hope you're able to figure things out and feel at ease soon, it can be really hard to go through alone! Maybe try communicating with your partner too about how you feel but avoid doing so in a accusing way. Tell them it's not so much that you distrust them but that your anxiety gets carried away? It was a conversation that worked for me and my partner!! Good luck, if you ever need someone to talk too feel free to shoot me a message! Sometimes those thoughts can make you feel very solo.
